## Title

    Fauna Hunt

## Short description

    Turn the simulator's wildlife into the point of the flight. A spotter
    calls contacts; you work out what you are looking at.

## Category

Tools / Utilities → In-game panels (whichever the form calls it). It is a
toolbar panel, not scenery and not an aircraft.

## Compatibility

Microsoft Flight Simulator **2024 only**. It uses an animal-finding call that
does not exist in 2020.

Works in 2D and in VR.

---

## Full description

Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 has 107 species of animal wandering the world.
Most people never notice them. Fauna Hunt turns finding them into the reason
for the flight.

It deliberately does **not** show you where the animals are. Developer mode can
already do that, and it removes the game. Instead the panel behaves like a
spotter calling contacts over the intercom — a compass sector at long range,
sharpening to an o'clock position as you close in — and it never tells you what
the animal is. Working that out by looking out of the window is the game.

**Identify** a herd from up to 1200 m, choosing from a shortlist of four.
Getting it right first time is worth the most. Then **capture** it by flying
within 150 m of the nearest animal, which is worth the identification again —
and it is what gets you down among them, low and slow, where the simulator
looks its best.

The **lifelist** tracks every species you have found out of all 107. Ones you
have not found yet show where in the world to go looking. Most of them are
African, so a bush trip over the Serengeti is worth far more than a lap of the
local farmland.

### Rarity

107 species across five tiers, from everyday cattle to eight legendary animals
that only appear in a few places on Earth. Rarer animals are worth more, and an
alert appears when a legendary one is nearby.

### Difficulty

Three settings, changing how early the panel gives detail away, with scoring to
match. Expert keeps you in the dark until you are almost on top of it and scores
50% more.

### Requirements

Nothing. There is no program to run, no executable, no account and no internet
connection. Copy one folder into Community and start the simulator.

The download is under a tenth of a megabyte.

---

## Notes to include

**In VR**, identification does not check where you are looking. The simulator
does not tell add-ons where a headset is pointing — every reading available
reports the aircraft instead. Rather than make you point the helicopter at an
animal to identify it, the rule is simply switched off in VR. In a 2D cockpit
view it works normally.

**There are no birds.** The simulator keeps its flying animals somewhere
add-ons cannot reach. Only ground animals are in the game.

**Turn up the fauna setting.** The simulator's own graphics settings have a
"Fauna" slider that controls how many animals exist. It is set separately for
normal and VR modes. Turning it up gives noticeably more to hunt.
